labels: Elbow against your inner thigh, arm long

text.setup: Sit on the end of a bench, lean forward and brace the back of your upper arm against your inner thigh, the bell hanging straight down.
cues: Curl the bell up towards your shoulder without moving the upper arm.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
mistakes: Using the leg to push the elbow and help the weight up.
Stopping short of a straight arm.

variants.cable: A single handle on a low pulley keeps tension at the bottom.
variants.kettlebell: The bell hangs below the handle, so the top is hardest.
